prototype_notice: Academic prototype — not a real blockchain.

encryption.unavailable_reason: No usable encryption key is configured, so protected notes cannot be saved or read.

ledger.note: Internally consistent means the recorded chain links up. It does not prove the database was never tampered with.

external_anchor.detail: No external permissioned ledger is configured; the audit chain is local only.

unprotected_categories: Customer profile (name, age, income, employment status, risk inputs)
Financial inputs and monthly financial records
Household finance records and household goals
Risk assessments, recommendations, analysis runs and agent logs
existing_data.note: Encryption applies only to protected notes. Everything listed here was stored before this feature and is not encrypted.

limitations: Identity is asserted by the client (X-Customer-Id); there is no server-side authentication, so a client that lies about its identity is not stopped.
The development key provider reads keys from the environment; it is not a managed key-management service.
The audit chain lives in the same database as the data: it detects accidental or partial edits, not a privileged attacker who rewrites the whole chain.
Only protected notes are encrypted; existing records stay in plaintext until they are deliberately migrated.
